headline: Congress named a Virginia Beach post office building after Ryan Keith Cox.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2509 George Mason Drive in Virginia Beach, Virginia, as the Ryan Keith Cox Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 21, 2019.
